speaker: charlie
text: Thanks Sam! Now for sports, and it's a big night for footy fans with <cite index="24-1,24-4">Hawthorn taking on Adelaide at UTAS Stadium tonight at 7:30pm</cite>. The Hawks have made some interesting selections while the Crows welcome back some key players - should be a cracker of a match!

speaker: alice
text: And Socceroos fans, listen up! <cite index="26-1">Football Australia has added 12 more players to the FIFA World Cup 2026 train-on squad</cite>, including some uncapped talent. The boys are really building depth ahead of what's shaping up to be an epic tournament in North America.

speaker: charlie
text: Love seeing that depth being built! The World Cup's still over a year away but the planning's already paying dividends. And with all the positive momentum in Australian sport right now, from grassroots to elite level, we're definitely punching above our weight on the world stage.
